attributes.action: Free feminine hygiene products for women and girls in the UK
attributes.additional_details: For years women and girls have had periods and had to pay for feminine hygiene products which isnt fair as it cant be helped. Imagine being a young girl and starting your period but not being prepared and being able to go into any shop that stores the products needed and get what you need for free..its already a scaring time but knowing we can go into a shop and feel safe and not need to worry if we can afford them would be magical
attributes.background: Women and girls need feminine hygiene products for their menstrual cycles which cannot be helped. I mean it shouldn't need much more explaining, Scotland did it so now its the uks turn

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Provide funding so all shops can offer free period products
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778900
